This is a case of acute liver failure (ALF) with rapid onset of hepatic encephalopathy and coagulopathy (INR 1.5), accompanied by marked transaminitis and severe hyperbilirubinemia. The absence of obvious precipitants — no recent medications, no alcohol escalation, no trauma or infection signs — narrows the differential but does not exclude key etiologies.
